tools.name: finish_attempt
tools.description: End a leased attempt with outcome, verification, and status. Kind determines required fields: set at claim_issue time.

acknowledged_changes.description: Optional acknowledgement of issue and event changes to prevent loss on concurrent updates.

agent_session_handle.description: Optional durable session handle for request attribution.

artifacts.description: Optional artifact references (links, files, or other work products) created or discovered during the attempt.

blocked_reason.description: Reason why a work attempt completed to blocked or review attempt completed to blocked. Required if target_issue_status=blocked (kind=work) or review_outcome=blocked (kind=review). Forbidden otherwise.

failure_reason_code.description: Reason code for failed outcome (outcome=failed). Required if outcome=failed. Forbidden for completed or interrupted outcomes.

idempotency_key.description: Optional key for idempotent retries; replays exact response for identical normalized requests.

interruption_reason_code.description: Reason code for interrupted outcome (outcome=interrupted). Required if outcome=interrupted. Forbidden for completed or failed outcomes.

lease_token.description: Opaque lease proof from claim_issue; required.

next_steps.description: Optional recovery or handoff steps (up to 20 items, 1000 chars each).

outcome.description: Outcome classification; required. One of: completed, failed, interrupted.

project_ref.description: Project reference returned by open_project. Pass it explicitly for stateless routing; omit only when using a configured default.

reason_details.description: Additional details about failure, interruption, or blocked outcome. Only allowed when target_issue_status=blocked (kind=work) or review_outcome=blocked (kind=review).

result_summary.description: Free-form completion summary or error description; required.

review_outcome.description: Review classification for review completion (outcome=completed, kind=review). Required for review completion. One of: approved, changes_requested, blocked. Forbidden for failed, interrupted, or work completion.

target_issue_status.description: Final issue status for work completion (outcome=completed, kind=work). Required for work completion. One of: done, review, ready, blocked. Forbidden for failed, interrupted, or review completion.

verification.description: Optional verification items demonstrated or tested (up to 20 items, 1000 chars each).

view.description: Output format: compact (default) or full with complete payloads.

tools.name: replace_review_request
tools.description: Atomically supersede a predecessor review request and create its open successor in one transaction.

artifact_ids.description: Artifact IDs the successor's frozen target covers. Not inherited: omitting this leaves the successor without artifacts even if the predecessor had them.

purposes.description: Purposes the successor covers. Omit to inherit the predecessor's purposes; a non-empty list must cover every purpose an active review_approval policy currently requires for this target, or the call fails with REVIEW_PURPOSE_REQUIRED.

target_event_id.description: Project event ID the reviewed work is current as of (latest_event_id from open_project, get_changes, or finish_attempt); reviewed work changing after it fails with STALE_REVIEW_TARGET.

target_issue_version.description: Issue version the successor reviews, from get_issue; must be current or the call fails with STALE_REVIEW_TARGET.

kind.description: Note classification: progress for routine status, finding for discoveries worth keeping, warning for risks or pitfalls, checkpoint for restartable state a successor resumes from (get_work_context surfaces the latest checkpoint). For durable decisions use record_decision; for issue-level discussion use add_comment.

instructions: Start with open_project using the absolute project root. Retain its project_ref and pass it to every subsequent project-scoped tool call; routing is stateless. Then use get_planning_graph or list_issues to find claimable work. Read get_work_context before claim_issue. While working, renew the lease and save restartable checkpoints; always finish_attempt on completion, failure, or handoff. Use expected_version for issue writes. Detailed guides: rhizome://guides/agent-workflow.
